# Independent source-role review (in progress)

Tuple: canonical c3f0513f56387540044fdb120e6a472e9015bdbd; FINAL-MANIFEST-v2 SHA-256 de537e86af8c3e0517624f77db73375fa66204d357b2057e723a661e240cfa5c; source patch SHA-256 de0bc617beec4981fdd9064fa7d375f45845ded1d1edb3dc21a2780b134be3cb. Matrix patch is outside this review. No canonical writes.

Preliminary: hashes match; reviewed actual product diffs, not only identifier parent context. Autocomplete switches outside boundary to owned form-field host; form field records described-by IDs by control WeakMap; input directive gains native disabled/readonly/aria bindings, node ElementRef injection, and forces inherited disabledInteractive false before parent lifecycle. Scoped prior standalone AOT and SSR observations support actual input/textarea/select node behavior; SSR used compiler/JIT fallback and does not prove hydration. Public protected API qualification remains separate. Source review is not a full behavior, peer-range, A01, G11, or release pass.

Pinned Node 24 execution of byte-control confirmed 326 current and 1663 frozen unselected row bytes unchanged; selected existing rows 5/73. Source-control replay in progress: current helper reports 325/6 to 331/1 with five existing and one added role, negative controls passed. Further checks pending.

Final disposition: no blocking source-role finding for this exact finite successor, conditional on the separate protected API decision. This is not approval of the matrix patch or a release gate. The retired-role type-proof adapter remains invalid; current admission is false and cannot be bypassed.

I compared actual c3f0513 product changes against 04daa4f8c, and the archived Material 16 input reference. Angular/Material package declarations identify version 22.1.7; MatInput's disabledInteractive and ngDoCheck declarations have no deprecation or docs-private marker; ElementRef is public and inject is public. The changed input's ElementRef is requested through node DI and typed to input, textarea, and select; it reads nodeName and getAttribute. I checked the actual standalone browser observations and SSR HTML and verified all seven fixture, assertion and output hashes in the independent review. They demonstrate native input, textarea and select observations on the tested peer, with SSR fallback and other limitations stated in the archived review. No new runtime suite was run in this review.

All 31 source manifest after images and applicable before images match bytes and hashes. Five prior source archives and five exact current source snapshots, 11 evidence archives, both complete prior ledgers, and seven prior full-review archives authenticate; each of 78 existing review records retains its previous fields and decision (with explicitly appended continuation and replaced evidence/source references). The exact selected records match their previous and successor ledgers: five current existing plus the new ElementRef role, and 73 frozen existing. The pinned Node byte control established 326/1663 raw unselected current/frozen rows unchanged. Forty-six removed common-module obligations remained unchanged and insufficient in the source control.

From the canonical working directory, pinned Node 24 source-control replay passed: current reviewed/insufficient 325/6 -> 331/1; frozen 1359/377 -> 1432/304; 1932 live uses in 509 files; current admission false, source snapshot and scope false, and the pre-existing additional-baseline error is 'changed retired-role type proof adapter'. The first execution from the external directory failed because its git lookup lacked repository context; the canonical-directory rerun passed and its actual adapter failure was retained. The pinned evidence control passed 79 selected positives and 281 distinct physical path tamper rejections. Separately, a minimal one-row fixture used the real helper against three current and three frozen examples, including new ElementRef: positive reviews passed; source, evidence and review-byte corruption and invalid conclusion were rejected. These checks establish binding and expected structural behavior, not the truth of a semantic claim; that was separately assessed from the bodies and scoped evidence.

No full A01/G11, peer 21, general API, full behavioral or runtime clearance is asserted. The three protected/inherited API disposition rows remain for their owner. No canonical files were changed.

semantic_boundary: Autocomplete owned host containment; per-control owned descriptions; native disabled/readonly/ARIA and added public Core ElementRef node DI. Exact bodies, authenticated previous contexts, original16/minimum22.1.7 declarations and scoped AOT/browser/SSR evidence support these roles. Matching identifier parents alone is not semantic approval.
